description.value: Alexander's Pub and Liquor Store sits on the shores of Kalamalka Lake in Coldstream, offering lakeside dining with an outdoor patio overlooking the water — a scenic stop for cyclists riding the Okanagan's lake routes. The pub serves a broad menu of comfort food including wings, nachos, burgers, and mains like halibut and ribs, alongside an attached liquor store. The combination of a full kitchen, patio seating, and a relaxed neighbourhood atmosphere makes it a practical and pleasant rest point on a touring ride.
